criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Raw Purdue BuildingShapes feature FID=249, code=SMTH, name=Smith Hall; 46 distinct official EPSG:4326 ring vertices. Builder rebuilds shell from that ring; GIS source is official but not survey-grade.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: Recomputed source-ring bbox via repository transform: [-307.75940550035415, -229.44217684119883, -484.47628505290595, -403.0344312639909]; saved mesh world XY bbox: [-307.9342346191406, -229.25146484375, -484.538818359375, -402.8434143066406]; edge deltas (m): [-0.17482911878647656, 0.1907119974488296, -0.06253330646904942, 0.19101695735025714]. Facade additions slightly extend the shell; exact footprint polygon shape cannot be reconstructed from aggregate bbox alone.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Source GIS reports 3 levels and an Extrution field of 26 with no published units. Mesh height is 12.00 m, set to 12 m by estimating from floors; no measured elevation or explicit roof-form source is recorded. Preview shows a flat roof.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: Preview shows red brick walls, three rows of repeated windows, a paired entrance with stone surround/lintel, and flat roof. Purdue Events source snapshot is an independent photo reference for brick facade and entrance, but window spacing and dimensions remain approximate.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Saved source library reopens in Blender; expected collection contains 1 object(s): ['Smith Hall']. Dedicated builder, config, raw GIS snapshot, captured Purdue Events page/photo, structured evidence, and preview are present. No external texture dependency is required.

findings: 12 m is an estimate based on the three-level GIS attribute; the source's Extrution=26 is undocumented here and should be investigated before claiming a verified height.
No measured facade dimensions or roof plans were found; keep the roof, window rhythm, and entrance dimensions marked approximate.
The modeled shell follows the official feature ring; small bbox differences come from doorway/facade additions and the source is not a certified survey.
